title: Mistral 7B Public Release
summary: Mistral AI publicly released Mistral 7B on September 27, 2023 under the Apache 2.0 license, with model weights and reference implementation access described in its first-party release materials.
significance: A documented public-release milestone for Mistral AI's first open language model family.
